Roles & capabilities
Spec §15.9: the role NFT configuration is external (spec §9) and this card only READS it — there is no address field to fill in. It shows the five-state lifecycle, why each chain role's capabilities are withheld, and the real path to re-verify. Buying and staking are NOT duplicated here: they live once on the Node NFT page.
There is NO address or network <input> on this card, on purpose (spec §1273). The externalized record is written by the CLI only — the copyable command is below.
What a verification is
read-only re-derivation of RoleStatus from the existing records; NOT on-chain verification — chainVerification stays false (spec §9/§115)
chainVerification (master switch, not written by this page)
false
Five-state vocabulary
none · acquired · staked · revoking · claimable
Effective capabilities
blog.read · blog.write · blog.publish
Withheld capabilities
(none)
Snapshot taken / via
2026-09-29T04:52:05.962Z · cli
The vocabulary is five states, in this order (scripts/lib/roles.mjs): none → acquired → staked → revoking → claimable → acquired. Only staked could ever activate a role, and even then chain verification is required. revoking derives to claimable at READ time once claimableAt has passed — the record is never rewritten. The words are shown again verbatim from the snapshot, so the page cannot drift from the engine.
Re-verify (read-only re-derivation)
This button is NOT a chain verification and does not pretend to be one. chainVerification is false and stays false (fail closed, spec §114/§115). What it really does: it writes ONE record under config/role-verify-intents/ and nothing else changes — the snapshot below is still the old one. The node's worker then re-derives every RoleStatus from the existing records (config/roles.json + node/profile.json), compares them with the public node/factories.json projection, and lands a timestamped snapshot. Until that worker runs, this page reports exactly what was true before the click.
Worker: node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify apply (once) or verify watch (keep running). Verified only by reading the records back — a toast is not evidence.
Re-verify from the existing records
Run the queued verifications once
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify apply
Keep verifying (the node worker)
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify watch
Re-derive now, without queueing
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify derive
Change the externalized config (the ONLY way — never in this UI)
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs init --update --studio-collection <addr> --hub-collection <addr> --network <net>

One row per role, read from node/role-status/<role>.json — a derived projection written by the verification worker, not a live browser read of the admin-only config record.

Verification intent queue
The queue lives in config/role-verify-intents (admin-only, the existing config collection — no permission change); a guest read is refused.
No items to display
Standing rule: a row appears here the moment the button is clicked, so an empty list means nothing has been queued on this node yet — it is not a claim about the snapshot above. The snapshot changes only when the worker runs.
Buy / stake a node NFT
Buy / mint, stake, revoke and claim are implemented ONCE, on the Node NFT page: four buttons that each queue one intent record, which the node's own chain worker signs on the node (the key never reaches the browser). This page only links there — a second set of buttons here would be a second, untested path.
Which state needs which action: none → buy / mint; acquired → stake; staked → nothing to do (capabilities stay withheld until chain verification exists); revoking → wait until claimableAt, then claim; claimable → claim back. The same four buttons are on the Node NFT page and every one of them only queues.

角色与能力
spec §15.9：角色 NFT 配置是外部化的（spec §9），本卡只**只读展示**——没有任何地址输入框。它展示五态生命周期、每个链角色能力为何被扣留，以及真实可用的「重新验证」路径。购买与质押不在此重复：它们在「节点 NFT」页只有一份实现。
本卡刻意**没有**任何地址或网络输入框（spec §1273）。外部化记录只能由 CLI 写入——可复制命令见下方。
验证是什么
read-only re-derivation of RoleStatus from the existing records; NOT on-chain verification — chainVerification stays false (spec §9/§115)
chainVerification（总开关，本页不写）
false
五态词表
none · acquired · staked · revoking · claimable
有效能力
blog.read · blog.write · blog.publish
被扣留的能力
(none)
快照时间 / 途径
2026-09-29T04:52:05.962Z · cli
词表共五态，顺序如下（scripts/lib/roles.mjs）：none → acquired → staked → revoking → claimable → acquired。只有 staked 有可能激活角色，且仍需链验证。revoking 在 claimableAt 到期后于**读取时**派生为 claimable——记录本身永不被改写。下方快照会逐字再列出这五个词，因此本页无法与引擎漂移。
重新验证（只读重推导）
本按钮**不是**链上验证，也不假装是。chainVerification 为 false 且保持 false（fail closed，spec §114/§115）。它真实做的事：在 config/role-verify-intents/ 下写一条记录，其余什么都不变——下方快照仍是旧的。随后由节点上的 worker 用既有记录（config/roles.json + node/profile.json）重新推导每个 RoleStatus，与公开投影 node/factories.json 比对，落下一份带时间戳的快照。在该 worker 运行之前，本页报告的完全是点击之前的事实。
Worker：node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify apply（执行一次）或 verify watch（常驻）。只以读回记录为证据——toast 不是证据。
用既有记录重新验证
执行一次队列中的验证
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify apply
常驻验证（节点 worker）
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify watch
不排队，直接重新推导
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs verify derive
修改外部化配置（唯一途径——绝不在本界面）
node scripts/arcblog-roles.mjs init --update --studio-collection <addr> --hub-collection <addr> --network <net>

常驻规则：点击按钮的瞬间这里就会出现一行，因此列表为空只表示本机还没有任何入队记录——它不是对上方快照的断言。快照只在 worker 运行时才改变。
购买 / 质押节点 NFT
购买 / 铸造、质押、撤回、取回只在「节点 NFT」页实现一次：四个按钮各自入队一条意图记录，由节点上的链 worker 在节点侧签名（私钥永不下发浏览器）。本页只做指引——在此再造一套按钮等于造第二条未经验证的路径。
各状态对应动作：none → 购买 / 铸造；acquired → 质押；staked → 无需操作（在链验证接通前能力仍被扣留）；revoking → 等到 claimableAt 后取回；claimable → 取回。同样四个按钮在「节点 NFT」页，且每个都只入队。
